messages:
Aisha: Quick design check — rolling out the new timeline: the rollback action is visually weak when the row is collapsed. Risk of accidental click. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/abc123
Marco: Agree. When timeline is compressed the primary action blends with secondary. Suggest elevating rollback to a destructive button pattern and adding a confirm modal.
Aisha: My mock shows a small inline icon + an expanded card with a prominent CTA. Concern: color ratio for colorblind users. Sample CSS I'm testing:
```css
.button-rollback { border: 2px solid #D9534F; background: transparent; color: #7A1A18; }
.button-rollback:focus { outline: 3px solid #FFBABA; }
```
Sam: Nice start. For a11y, don't rely on color alone. Propose `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217,83,79,0.25)` and `aria-describedby="rollback-desc"` on the button so the confirm text is read.
Jun: Contrast check — current icon color fails 3:1 in low-light themes. Interactive text needs 4.5:1. Also ensure confirm modal uses `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and keyboard trap.
Priya: On canary flows: if we make rollback more prominent, will users accidentally trigger it during quick checks? Maybe hide the heavy confirm behind an overflow menu unless the card is expanded.
Zoe: Data note: ~2% of rollbacks last quarter looked accidental and correlate with quick clicks on the timeline. Reducing accidental surface area should be a priority.
Aisha: New proposal: keep a compact icon in the timeline row for low-friction fixes, but only show the full red 'Rollback' CTA inside the expanded snapshot card. For high-risk routes, require a typed-confirm step.
Marco: Love the typed-confirm for high-risk. Suggest a tiered confirmation: quick rollback (no typing) for canary <5% traffic; typed-confirm for >5% or prod-tagged routes.
Sam: Implementation note — confirm flow needs a flag from the server indicating route criticality. I'll add a `data-criticality="high"` attribute to the DOM so we can toggle behavior + styles.
Aisha: Also copy question: Should the quick action be labeled 'Rollback' or 'Revert to version'? I feel 'Revert to version' is clearer when the user chooses a snapshot.
Zoe: Agree — use 'Revert to version' in the history picker, keep 'Rollback' as the quick action label in the drilldown.
Jun: Accessibility microcopy: add an `aria-live="polite"` status region for success/failure messages like 'Rollback started' / 'Rollback succeeded' so SR users get immediate feedback.
Sam: I'll prototype keyboard-only flows tonight (tab order, focus return, escape to cancel) and post a short vid.
Aisha: Can we get a quick pass on contrast and focus before EOD? I'll update Figma and ping reviewers.
design-bot: New design comment created by Aisha on Figma: https://figma.com/file/rollout-456
Zoe: tagging @eng-oncall for any safety guards / rate-limit concerns.
Priya: noted — will sync with eng-oncall about rate limits and accidental-stop protections.
Aisha: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
